On a single site the occupations $n_1$ and $n_2$ of the two spin species are fermionic number operators,
so each has eigenvalues $0$ and $1$. The Hubbard interaction can be written through the total charge,
\begin{equation}
U n_1 n_2 = \frac{U}{2}\left(n_1 + n_2\right)^2 - \frac{U}{2}\left(n_1 + n_2\right) .
\label{eq:hub}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
